locator: Approach description / Stages of implementation / (a) Site identification
quote: Stages of implementation: (a)Site identification wherein ideal sites for ANR implementation are those with 600-700 vigorous wildlings per hectare with 15-200 cm height of pioneer species, brush and other woody species relatively well spread on the area
interpretation: Ideal-site guidance, not hard exclusion endpoints; retain joint criteria and pioneer/brush/woody-species scope. Density and height are not rootstock presence or tree-canopy percent.
status: Candidate source reading only. No EV, approval, calibration or global transfer granted.
